title: Kenworth K108 custom FUPS Bullbar #33
description: Kenworth K108 FUPS high tensile aluminium Bullbar. Three main one piece 76mm cross tubes through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights. Driving light mount to suit application, provision for lower front marker lights and optional lower flap. Front mudflap mounts are standard. Optional indicator repeater lights to outer uprights. Bullbar can be custom built to your specifications.
